capabilities: create and edit .simpledraw files in the vault
draw textboxes with Markdown rendering, shapes, and styling
connect elements with arrows that snap to anchors and route around boxes
add Markdown labels to arrows and toggle line styles and arrowheads
export the canvas as a PNG with optional grid or transparent background
disambiguation: Not a freehand sketch tool; drawings are built from textboxes and arrows, not pen strokes.
extras: A standalone desktop version exists that runs without Obsidian (multi-window, system tray, native file save). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugins folder). Interface is bilingual (Chinese/English).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in lightweight editor for simple flowcharts stored as their own files.
summary: Drawing plugin that creates and edits .simpledraw flowchart files in Obsidian, using Markdown-rendering textboxes and snappable arrows.
